How Token Eyes calculates and protects leaderboard data
This leaderboard is for community sharing and entertainment only. It is not a certification or performance evaluation.

Leaderboard usage sync uploads only aggregated Token counts, Agent, model, time bucket and estimated cost. WeChat sign-in also stores your nickname, avatar, a one-way stable account identifier and an internally generated non-deliverable email for account linking. Prompts, responses, code and raw log content are never uploaded; raw openid, unionid and WeChat access tokens are never stored.
Today, yesterday, 7-day and 30-day periods use UTC+8 natural-day boundaries. Total covers all successfully synced aggregate records.
With cache uses total Tokens. Without cache subtracts cache-read and cache-creation Tokens and never falls below zero. Estimated cost uses the current Token Eyes pricing table.
Scores are sorted from high to low. Ties are resolved by total Tokens and then stable user ID, so users are not repeated or skipped between pages.
Repeated reports for the same source, model and time bucket are deduplicated. Multiple devices are merged by the same aggregation rules rather than blindly added twice.
Estimated cost is a reference calculation based on the current model price table. Discounts, grants and provider billing may differ from the final invoice.
